text:
Ravi: Hi folks, kicking off the OnNexus Terraform starter handoff for Cloud Partner Z. Goal: reference-arch + minimal modules + CI examples by May 10.
Ellen: Proposal: ship GKE first for partner pilot, then add EKS. Keep modules: network, k8s_cluster, node_pool, ingress, kms.
Tom: I'll scaffold modules and version them as v0.1. Will add clear inputs/outputs. ETA Apr 28 for initial PR.
Yuna: I'll create the partner-facing README and a one-page quickstart. Also add a troubleshooting FAQ. ETA Apr 26.
Ravi: partner wants example variable sets for "production" and "dev-slim". Include cost/perf notes.
Tom: will add examples/prod.tfvars and examples/dev-slim.tfvars with comments.
Ellen: CI plan: GH Actions with validation/plan.yml and gated apply to a sandbox project. Add terraform fmt + validate steps.
InfraBot: Reminder: partner-iac-ticket PN-452 created (owner: Ravi).
Yuna: I'll draft the marketplace blurb and 2 screenshots. Who can produce a 20s deploy gif?
Tom: I can record a short deploy gif using the sandbox; will add to assets/.
Ravi: action items:
 - Tom: modules + examples (due Apr 28)
 - Yuna: README + marketplace assets (due Apr 26)
 - Ellen: CI workflows + provider versions (due Apr 24)
Ravi: small ask: add a hardware compatibility appendix (Arm/Graviton/Ampere) as an appendix marked "experimental".
Tom: noted. I'll include recommended instance families and a short perf note.
Ellen: also add a terraform.lock and pin provider versions to prevent drift.
Yuna: scheduling partner kickoff Wed 9am PT, invite sent.
Ravi: keep module outputs stable (cluster_name, kubeconfig_secret, node_pool_ids). We'll maintain a changelog and semver policy.
Tom: will add CHANGELOG.md and a releases.md outlining bump rules.
InfraBot: Checklist status: repo-skeleton (open), modules (open), CI (open), examples (open), marketplace-assets (open).
Ravi: thanks all. We'll reconvene after PRs land. :v:
